transcript.content: Hello, welcome in—I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm just here because I'm... really tired lately. Exhausted, really. It's the kind where sleep doesn't seem to fix it. Just getting through a normal workday, and then dealing with dinner at home... it all just feels a lot heavier than it should.
Over the past two weeks, have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy?

Um... yeah, I suppose. I usually like painting... or going to museum exhibits. But recently... I don't know. I just leave my supplies untouched. I just can't really make myself care enough to go do any of it right now.
How long have you been feeling this way—the tiredness and not caring about painting or museums—has it been going on for a couple of weeks, or longer, like months or years?
Um... about a month, I guess. It's been a bit of a swing... I was actually pretty energized and driven right before this. But yeah... this low feeling has been going on for about a month.
During that time before you started feeling low, did you notice you needed less sleep than usual but still felt full of energy?

Um... yeah, I suppose so. During that stretch, I was sleeping... maybe four hours a night. But I'd still get up feeling ready to go. I'd just start... sending work emails, sketching out event ideas, or... reorganizing the kitchen. I just didn't really need the sleep then.
That period when you felt like you needed less sleep and had a lot of energy—about how many days in a row did that last?
Um... I'm not entirely sure. Maybe... a few days? I didn't really keep track.
During that period when you felt full of energy and needed less sleep, did you notice yourself talking more than usual or having racing thoughts?

Um... well, my husband mentioned something about it. And a couple of people at work... they said I was talking really fast. Like they couldn't get a word in because I kept jumping into the conversation. So... I guess I was.
Have you noticed any unexplained changes in your weight recently, either gaining or losing weight without changing your diet?

Um... maybe a little bit. I'm not trying to lose weight, but... I guess my skirts are fitting a little looser lately. I've just been... picking at my meals, mostly. Or forgetting to eat lunch at work. So... yeah.
